availability.note: Audi Australia magazine 13 Aug 2026 'New hybrid Q5 arrives' lists the Q5 e-hybrid SUV with MLP; Chasing Cars (13 Aug 2026) calls it the 'sole e-Hybrid specification' in SUV and Sportback; CarExpert price-and-specs still lists the PHEV. audi.com.au configurator returned HTTP 403 to automated reads on 2026-11-26, so not read directly.

listPrice.note: Audi AU Manufacturer List Pricing, 'excludes dealer delivery and government statutory charges': SUV $96818. Same figure 'before on-road costs' in words at https://www.carsguide.com.au/ev/audi-q5-e-hybrid-102380 and https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-reviews/2026-audi-q5-e-hybrid-review-quick-drive. Replaces the Nov 2025 launch figure $96900 (still shown in CarsGuide's Glass's table and carsales research); manufacturer price preferred per owner convention.

batteryKwh.note: usable: 25.9 kWh gross, 20.7 kWh net on the same page; Chasing Cars also states 20.7 kWh usable

rangeKm.note: Audi AU: 'up to 82km (on the WLTP cycle)' for the AU 270kW car; CarExpert and Chasing Cars 82 km WLTP. CarsGuide says up to 88 km and auto-data 81-92 km (EU band); the AU figure is used.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 20.7 / 82 x 100. Audi weighted kWh/100km (16.1-17.2) is utility-factor weighted, not used.

combinedRangeKm.note: 82 km WLTP electric + 55 L tank / 7.8 L/100km x 100 = 82 + 705. Tank 55 L from https://www.auto-data.net/en/audi-q5-iii-gu-2.0-tfsi-367hp-e-hybrid-quattro-ultra-s-tronic-54561 (Chasing Cars says 70 L, judged a petrol-Q5 figure; EU spec sources agree on 55 L for the PHEV).

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: Audi's WLTP 'battery discharged' combined band for the 270 kW car is 8.1-7.2 L/100km (https://www.audi.com/en/audi-q5-suv-e-hybrid-quattro-16677); 7.8 kept from held data, upper half of the band for the AU car's standard 20-inch wheels and 2,170+ kg mass. Siblings: mercedes-glc-phev 7.8, bmw-x3-phev 7.6, audi-a5-phev 7.3 (lighter, same powertrain). No independent AU charge-sustaining test found.

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: combined label 3.3 L/100km (also Audi AU magazine and carsales) <= 3.5

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO green passenger car: combined tailpipe CO2 <= 120 g/km; CarExpert quotes 75 g/km

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: Audi press release SUV 438 L / 1358 L (VDA, to the cover); Chasing Cars and CarsGuide agree on seats-up. CarExpert's 520/1473 is the petrol Q5 figure (trap).

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: Audi press release SUV folded 1358 L; Chasing Cars agrees

towKg.note: CarExpert: 2,000 kg braked for the AU e-hybrid; auto-data and carsales research agree

warrantyYears.note: 5 years / unlimited km; battery 8 yr / 160,000 km. Chasing Cars and CarsGuide also five years.

insuranceAnnual.note: kept held figure; anchored to mercedes-glc-phev 2500 ($99.9k), volvo-xc60-phev-ultra-t8 2400 ($102k), audi-a5-phev 2350 ($89.9k), audi-q6-e-tron-rwd 2600

depreciationCurve.note: Audi brand curve matching audi-q4-e-tron [1,0.67,0.55,0.46,0.39,0.33], per owner convention (one curve per brand). Held curve was [1,0.68,0.56,0.48,0.41,0.35].
